levelAssTooltip.title: Main Stat Level Assumption
levelAssTooltip.desc: Sets main stat value to at least that of the specified level. Does not change substats.

tcGraph.desc: Using data from the builder, this will generate a graph to visualize Optimization Target vs. the selected Graph Target. The graph will show the maximum Optimization Target value per 0.01 of the selected Graph Target. Enabling this is optional, and doing so will slow down build times
tcGraph.buildAlreadyInList: Build is already in the list

upOptLevelFilterTooltip: This level filter is not synced with Optimize config.
upOptNoResults: It looks like there aren't any artifacts available for upgrading that could enhance your setup. Your artifact filters might be too restrictive. Alternatively, try the main artifact optimizer to find a better build.
upOptInfo:
The Artifact Upgrader identifies artifacts with high potential to boost the Optimization Target's value, guiding you to artifacts worth leveling up.
As it only swaps one artifact at a time, for the best overall build across all artifacts, use the main artifact optimizer.
upOptEmptyBuild: You're using a partially empty build. Since the Artifact Upgrader only swaps artifacts individually, completing a set is unlikely. It's recommended to begin with a base build, preferably generated from the main Optimizer.

upOptReshape.label: Reshape
upOptReshape.tooltip:
Evaluate level 20 artifacts as reshape candidates. Each eligible artifact is scored once per substat pair, for 6 total combinations.
Note: This requires importing your data using <4>Irminsul
upOptReshape.rolls: Number of rolls into the guaranteed substats:

upOptDefine.label: Define
upOptDefine.tooltip: Evaluate hypothetical artifacts created by defining (Sanctifying Elixirs). Candidates are generated for the selected sets, slots, main stats, and every pair of the selected substats below.
upOptDefine.setsEmpty: No sets are being considered. Enable Define with at least 2 substats, and pick an optimization target.
upOptDefine.setsArbitrary: No available set affects the optimization target in these slots, so an arbitrary set (highlighted above) was picked just so results show up.

excludeArt.title_tooltip: Add artifacts to this character's exclusion list. Artifacts in the exclusion list will not be considered for build generation.
excludeArt.addExc: Add artifact to this character's exclusion list
excludeArt.selExc: Select artifact to add to this character's exclusion list
excludeArt.deSelectExc: Click on an artifact to remove it from the exclusion list
excludeArt.includeArtifactTip: Including an artifact will allow the build generator to use it for this character.

optExcludeModal.excludeMsg: Are you sure you want to exclude {{count}} artifacts from build optimization?
optExcludeModal.includeMsg: Are you sure you want to include {{count}} artifacts to build optimization?

modal.allow_all: Add all shown characters to the allow list
modal.disallow_All: Remove all shown characters from the allow list

useTeamArts: Use artifacts in teammates' active builds

constraintFilter.title: Minimum build constraints
constraintFilter.tooltip: Set certain minimum requirements that generated builds must conform to; e.g., have at least 140% Energy Recharge.

artSetConfig.title: Artifact Set Configuration

setCond.title: Artifact Set Conditional Effects
setCond.text: Some artifact set effects provide conditional stats. This window allows you to select those effects, so they can contribute stats when a build that satifies a set effect is calculated during optimization.

ArtSetFilter.title: Artifact Sets <1>Allowed<1></1></1> / <3>Excluded<1></1></3>
ArtSetFilter.intro: You can allow/exclude which sets you want the builder to consider. In the following examples, A is on-set, and R is rainbow(off-set)

artSetConfig.heading: Artifact sets
artSetConfig.description: Choose which set bonuses the optimizer may use, and turn on set effects that need a condition.

row.excludedNote: not used, the {{num}}-piece bonus is excluded

settings.teammatesHint: Also use artifacts from teammates' active builds
settings.gpuUnsupported: This browser has no WebGPU: the CPU is used.
settings.gpuOnHint: Searches use the GPU (WebGPU). Click to go back to the CPU (the default).
settings.gpuOffHint: Searches use the CPU. Click to let them use the GPU (WebGPU): faster for some searches, slower for others.

buildDropdownDesc: Decreasing the number of generated build will decrease build calculation time for large number of builds.
threadDropdownDesc: Increasing the number of threads will speed up build time, but will use more CPU power.
noArtis: Oops! It looks like you haven't added any artifacts to Stellar Optimizer yet! You should go to the <1>Artifacts</1> page and add some!

optAlert.scalesWith: The selected Optimization target and constraints scales with:

selectChar: Select a character to generate builds.
notifyTooltip: Play a sound when builds finish generating. Will also show an alarm prompt when tabbed out.

improve.craftingInfo: Also rank artifacts you could reshape (level 20, needs data imported from Irminsul) or create by defining.
improve.reshapeHint: Score level 20 artifacts as reshape candidates
improve.defineHint: Score artifacts you could create with two chosen substats
improve.unmetTitle: This build does not meet its minimum build constraints
improve.unmetHint: An upgrade only counts when the whole build meets them, and no single artifact gets this build there. Lower or switch off the constraint, or start from a build the Optimizer made.
improve.unfillableHint: No artifact for it is a 5★ within the level range that also passes the main stats and set rules, and nothing else beats the pieces equipped. Widen the level range or those options, or equip one first.
improve.nothingBetterTitle_one: The one artifact considered is unlikely to beat what is equipped
improve.nothingBetterTitle_other: None of the {{count}} artifacts considered is likely to beat what is equipped
improve.nothingBetterHint: These pieces already do well for this target. To go further, let the Optimizer find a better full build, or use Stat value above to see which stats to farm next.
improve.noFiveStar_one: The upgrader only levels 5★ artifacts, and the one in range is not 5★.
improve.noFiveStar_other: The upgrader only levels 5★ artifacts, and none of the {{count}} in range is 5★.
improve.setRulesTitle: Every candidate breaks the artifact set rules
improve.setRulesHint: Swapping any of the {{count}} 5★ artifacts in range into this build would break the set rules under Artifact sets. Loosen them in More options, or start from a build that already meets them.
improve.mainStatsHint: None of the {{count}} artifacts left has a main stat allowed under Main stats. Allow more in More options.
improve.sharedNote: These options are shared with the Optimize tab: changing them here changes them there too. Only the level range above is the Improve tab's own.

substatValue.title: Substat value
substatValue.info: The exact gain of the optimization target if this build had extra rolls of each substat. Use it to pick the substats to look for when leveling, rolling or reshaping artifacts.
substatValue.noTarget: Choose an optimization target to see which substats raise it the most.
substatValue.noScaling: This target does not depend on any substat.
substatValue.unavailable: Substat value is not available for this target.
substatValue.colNextHint: What one more roll adds after the rolls picked, as a share of the target at that point
substatValue.captionRolls: {{size}} {{rarity}}★ rolls on top of this build (target now {{base}}); set the rolls per substat with − and +.

statValue.title: Stat value
statValue.info: The exact gain of the optimization target from better stats on this build: a few more rolls of each substat, or another main stat on sands, goblet and circlet. Use it to pick what to farm, level, roll or reshape.

farm.title: What to farm
farm.noTarget: Pick an optimization target to see which stats to farm.
